CONFIRMED BREAK (1, P1): D1 — AbortSignal fired at the COMMIT that spends the ticket/queues the receipt/stores the scored shot → outcome {unavailable, cause:'cancelled', 'This analysis was cancelled. Your capture is still saved.'} while the spend is durable (spendable 1 / consumed 1, 1 receipt, 1 scored local_shot). The live path pins 'recovery_pending' for the identical race (runCaptureJournalIntegration.test.ts). Cause: the post-commit replay branch is gated on !cancelled and the offline branch never marks the run journal 'committed', so readCommitStatus()=not_committed → cleanup('cancelled') → cancelledOutcome(). Money is not lost (a re-run of the same operation replays the paid rating without spending again), hence P1 not P0.

ATTACKS THAT HELD (9 passing, VERIFIED on candidate):
- D2 corrupt product row: local_shot payload altered after the receipt paid for it → drain presents output:null under the same receipt id/digest/grant; server refusal recorded honestly (evidence {refused, code}), shot not marked synced, ticket stays consumed (no local refund); same-operation replay never returns the altered rating as paid and spends nothing more (throws identity_conflict / non-scored).
- D3 corrupt write-ahead journal row ('applied' entry with NULL verdicts): drain fails typed offline.wallet_corrupt before any POST, receipt stays queued unsettled, nothing invented; a new court-offline read still rates and spends exactly one ticket (freeLimitReached true after the second).
- D4 429 + Retry-After on the 2nd chunk of one drain (presentationMaxChars:1): chunk 1 acceptance durable (shot synced), chunk 2 left in_flight as HOLD (phase presented_unanswered, evidence {held, answered:false}, wallet hold=true) — not refused, not dropped; next drain recovers and settles the same receipt id once (journal applied/superseded/applied).
- D5 HELD ('pending') then accepted on a later drain: held receipt not re-presented in the same drain, phase 'held', evidence {held, answered:true}, a second HOLD is idempotent, acceptance writes exactly one shot.sync receipt.
- D6 REFUSED (grant_revoked): evidence {refused, code}, receipt final (never re-presented), same operation replays the paid rating with no new spend/receipt, refused ticket stays 'consumed' locally.
- D7 trusted clock unreadable at spend (after inference): honest 'unavailable', nothing spent/queued/stored; same operation id is then 'recovery_pending' (existing journal design — a released run is not re-run under its own id; matches base behaviour for a failed offline reservation, INFERRED), a new operation on the same capture rates and spends one ticket.
- D8 spend-time reading with rollbackDetected:true (2 days back): nothing authorised, nothing spent/queued/stored.

OBSERVATION (not a break, VERIFIED): after any honest offline no-score at commit (time_reconcile_required / allocation_exhausted / grant_expired) the operation's run-journal row is left release_pending/failed with permit_id NULL, and the run journal's recovery needs a LIVE permit reservation to settle it — so that operation id stays 'awaiting recovery' until the device is online; a fresh operation id rates normally. Whether the shipping AnalyzeScreen retry issues a fresh operation id offline was not tested (UNKNOWN).

Not modified: candidate production code, candidate tests, migrations, Supabase, Mac runner.

residual_risks: An offline-paid journal row stays release_pending/held on the device (it never becomes a permit-backed completion); the sweep treats it as settled work, not unfinished recovery.
Chunk size is measured on the JSON wire length (1_000_000 chars) under the Edge 2 MB body cap; a single receipt larger than the cap is still sent alone.

readOfflineReceiptForResult() pre-filters candidate rows with an owner-scoped `receipt LIKE %"<resultId>"%` JSON substring match and then confirms parseReceiptRow(row).resultId === resultId; a normalized result_id column would replace the substring pre-filter in a later schema change.

A receipt whose grant row is unreadable stays queued indefinitely on the device (reported as `unreadable`); it is settled only if the grant bytes become readable again or the owner purges the account. It is never presented under bytes the device cannot vouch for.
implement.summary: Court-offline scored read on the shipping path (AnalyzeScreen -> prepareOriginalCaptureAnalysis -> runOriginalCaptureAnalysis) and on plain runCaptureAnalysis: connectivity-class permit failure + cached release policy + executable held grant -> on-device rating, exactly one consumeOfflineAllocation() in the commit transaction, saveOfflineAnalysis() writes local_shot (digest-bound to the receipt) with NO shot.sync outbox row, the receipt drain sends the frozen 1.0 wire entry { receipt, grant:{schemaVersion,compactJws}, output } in bounded chunks, hasShotSyncReceipt() is written only on an accepted settlement, a lost commit acknowledgement returns the durable paid read, the SHIPPING sync runtime's recovery sweep never reserves a live permit for an operation already paid offline, an owner purge removes every offline wallet row of that owner, and the Result surface names queued / presented-unanswered / HELD / REFUSED / ACCEPTED receipts truthfully. r8 (coordinator follow-up on the ACCEPTED r7, new commit 48d3db71 on top of 389bfbf7, nothing amended) closes the verify-7 adversary's four residual breaks: (P2) the offline commit re-reads trusted time at the moment of spending and consumeOfflineAllocation() judges the lease with THAT reading — a lease that expires during inference returns the honest `unavailable` outcome, consumes zero allocations, writes no receipt and no scored local_shot; an unreadable clock at spend time is offline.time_reconcile_required, mapped to the same `unavailable`; (P2) a pending receipt whose offline_grant row is missing or fails its stored digest is skipped by the drain — never presented, never dropped, reported in `unreadable` — so the owner's other receipts under intact grants still settle instead of the whole drain aborting; (P3) freeLimitReached is computed from every ACTIVE held identity_lifetime_free grant on the device after the spend (true only when no free ticket remains spendable), not from the paying grant alone; (P3) authority selection prefers a held verified_store lease over spending an identity_lifetime_free ticket (Pro court-offline read: ticket null, free tickets untouched).
